note: Calibrated 2026-10-04 by Yasser Awadein. Real topology: ore belt runs jetty -> DRP (DRP has its own ore intake); scrap is NOT belted — scrap trucks + scrap buckets under the charging bay overhead crane feed the EAF, setting the DRI:scrap blend per charge.

conveyors.name: Ship Unloader + Overland Belt (jetty -> DRP)
conveyors.notes: the most expensive logistics item — port infrastructure is a massive upfront investment

conveyors.name: DRI Belt (DRP -> EAF)
conveyors.notes: standard covered conveyor; gentle handling (DRI is friable); hot vs cold DRI charging is a later upgrade axis

conveyors.name: Hot Delivery Line (CCM -> billet yard)
conveyors.notes: roller tables + insulated conveyors to keep billet hot for hot charging; hot charging vs yard cooling is a Phase 2 upgrade

conveyors.name: Billet Carrier (billet yard -> wire rod mill)

scrap_feed.name: Scrap Trucks + Charging Bay (buckets)
scrap_feed.mechanism: scrap trucks (20-25 t) from yard to loading bay; scrap buckets charged under the charging bay overhead crane
scrap_feed.capex_note: truck fleet + charging bay crane + buckets — band for Yasser to confirm
scrap_feed.notes: sets the scrap:DRI blend ratio available per charge; blend per steel grade + raw material availability
